concept_en: The Time Limit of a Development Lead
question_cn: 苏格兰弃兵中白方弃兵获得发展领先。为什么发展优势有「时限」，不能永久持续？
question_en: In the Scotch Gambit, why is White's development lead temporary rather than permanent?

options.text_cn: 发展优势没有时限，一旦领先就永远领先
options.text_en: A development lead has no time limit; once ahead, you stay ahead forever.

options.text_cn: 随着棋局进行，黑方会自然完成发展，速度差缩小；若白方未在「临界点」前将速度转化为攻击或位置优势，多余的兵将成为长期优势
options.text_en: Black will catch up in development. If White does not turn the lead into an attack or positional gain in time, Black's extra pawn may become a lasting advantage.

options.text_cn: 发展优势在残局才有价值，中局不重要
options.text_en: A development lead matters only in the endgame, not the middlegame.

options.text_cn: 时限是指对方的思考时间有限
options.text_en: The time limit refers to the opponent's clock.

explanation_cn: 弃兵方的发展优势是「动态」的，像沙漏一样会流失。每经过几步棋，黑方会逐渐补上发展（出动棋子、王入城），速度差收窄。「临界点」是指那个发展优势仍然足够大、可以转化为具体攻击的时机。错过临界点后，黑方稳定下来，多余的兵成为长期物质优势。弃兵方必须在临界点前发动决定性攻击——这是判断弃兵是否成立的核心问题。
explanation_en: A gambiteer's development lead is dynamic and fades over time. Black can develop pieces and castle, narrowing the gap. The critical moment is when the lead is still large enough to create a concrete attack or positional gain. If White misses it, Black may consolidate and the extra pawn can become a lasting material advantage.
